newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Low demand deters Bulgaria depo rates from rising.
newsitem.headline: Low demand deters Bulgaria depo rates from rising.

text.p: Bulgarian interbank deposit rates were flat from Friday despite a rise in the central bank main interest rate as demand for funds was low, dealers said.
"Banks enjoy ample liquidity and supply of funds tops demand. Rates are flat although the central bank has raised its main rate," said a dealer.
The central bank raised its simple annual main lev interest rate to 5.50 percent from 5.42 percent, effective Monday.
Interbank overnight lev deposit rates stood at 1.50-1.75 percent annually, flat from Friday. Spot week lev rates were also unchanged at 2.5-3.0 percent annually.
The average annual interbank deposit rate was 1.84 percent on Friday, up from 1.39 percent on Thursday, a central bank official said. -- Dessislava Popova, Sofia Newsroom +359-2 91188
